column2: A doctor in a white coat sitting at a desk talking calmly with a middle-aged patient, the patient holds a small medicine box in one hand while the doctor gestures kindly. A sense of trust and dialogue.
A blister pack of pills and a small medicine bottle next to a simple wall calendar page with a few squares crossed out, suggesting counting days before an appointment. Objects only, no people.

A tidy folder with a few medical exam papers and blood test sheets sticking out, next to a small list paper and an identity card. One sheet shows a simple grey abstract ultrasound scan of a bean-shaped KIDNEY organ. Absolutely no baby, no fetus, no pregnancy imagery. Objects only, no people, no readable writing.
A person sitting on a bed at home holding their lower back with a slightly worried face, with a small coral warning circle near them suggesting attention. Calm, not dramatic.
